notes: The addon goes into the game at once, also while the game is running; the program then says to quit the game and start it again (a new addon loads only when the game starts).
Getting started: until the program knows your characters, every page shows what is left — the game's folder, the addon, logging in, /reload — and ticks the steps off as they are done.
Settings → Game and data → The game: a Browse button opens Windows' folder window; the program also finds the game through its entry in Installed apps and Battle.net's settings, on any drive.
The game and the addon are at the top of Settings → Game and data.
